newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russian Duma to lift exemptions on firms' reserves.
newsitem.headline: Russian Duma to lift exemptions on firms' reserves.

text.p: A parliament-government conciliation commission reviewing the 1997 draft budget has backed a government proposal to end tax-exempt reserves for companies, Itar-Tass news agency said on Thursday.
The commission supported a government amendment to company law ending a requirement to set aside compulsory reserves, which are exempt from taxes, it said.
It quoted Deputy Finance Minister Sergei Shatalov as saying the measure would raise 1.3 trillion roubles in tax for the government.
The Russian government is trying to find new sources of revenue after this year's poor tax collection performance.
It has threatened several companies, which it says are behind in paying taxes, with bankruptcy.
